says: Forty years setting snares. The wood gives, if you don't take too much.
Leif's a good lad. Too soft on the wolves. They aren't soft on him.

folk.says: Herring up to the smokehouse, a basket at a time. My arms are twice the size of Arne's.

says: White hair since birth, every one of us. Mother says it's the snow got in.
Leif's my brother. If he offers you a fox pelt, haggle. He always starts too high.
